notes.title: Update ver.1.3.1
notes.notes:
-Stage Selection Feature Added
Until now, maps have been randomly assigned when you join a match; however, you will now be able to choose which map you would like to play when you start a "Quick Match" or "Friend Match".
For both Quick Matches and Friend Matches, the host will be allowed to choose the map. 
*The host is the player who name is on the left of the projector display.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/03146e76aec141c6f87f1204a390af950496df6c.png[/img]
Decide which match to play together over voice chat!

-Other updates
BGM volume can now be set to one of three levels.
Set it to whatever level is most suitable to your play style.

notes.title: Update ver.1.2.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Stages Added![/h1]
2 all new stages have just been added!

[b]-Marine Container Stage[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/2f4d319331ae6a65d02bba4b6c21d3fc760fb669.png[/img]
This dockside setting is littered with bullet proof containers.
Take advantage of them as cover or for ambushes and broaden your strategic horizons!

[b]-Galaxy Stage[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/efe64ded019b9c4651b7cef2dc6ba7f0be8b53a3.png[/img]
Passing through the warp holes sprinkled about this stage will teleport you to a random location!
Take advantage of these warp holes and enjoy the peculiar gravity in this stage!

[h1]New Masks![/h1]
There are still more additions to the shop!
2 variations of 3 new masks, the Octopus, Knight, and Curse masks are now available.

[b]-Octopus[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/64a721a0e7849b762f9516ae097fb5815aa2c977.gif[/img]
A mask with tentacles that shake when you turn your head
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/524870]>Check Here[/url]

[b]-Knight[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/bae5b51db69224b2d50ebde57f03a20978c976d6.gif[/img]
A shining, noble mask
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/525221/]>Check Here[/url]

[b]-Curse[/b]
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/1c75c89f3edc894e3c9490b10d8cca5642e063a7.gif[/img]
A mask with a dark cursed aura eminating from it
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/525220/]>Check Here[/url]

[b]-Value Pack[/b]
All 3 masks and their variations for one low price!
*masks are purely cosmetic and will not effect player performance
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/1507/]>Check Here[/url]

As always, enjoy Dig 4 Destruction!

notes.title: Update ver.1.1.0
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/79c9192770626ca8f31b1355966c8adbcc76c07c.png[/img]
Greetings!
We are happy to announce the addition of the much awaited "Friend Match" feature!
With this new feature, you will be able to host a room which only your friends on Steam can join.
So call you friends, and prepare to Dig 4 Destruction together!

Also, to improve the wait times for a matching, we have consolidated the "Host Match" and "Join Match" to a simple "Quick Match" option.

We hope you'll continue to enjoy Dig 4 Destruction!

notes.title: Update schedule notice
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25985970/82154645d4aaa87daef0ba14255fc6576ebc02a9.png[/img]
Is everyone enjoying Dig 4 Destruction?
To make Dig 4 Destruction even more fun, we will be adding the oft requested feature as part of the upcoming update ver.1.1.0.

ver.1.1.0
- "Friend Matches" will allow you to play matches with your friends.

Friend Matches allow you to open matching rooms that will only be available to your friends on Steam.
Hop on voice chat to talk with your friends as you do battle!

So call your friends and get ready to Dig 4 Destruction together.
